$comment: City of Mages Grimoire v1.9.3 structured-delta patch (2026-07-12). THE THREE WORKINGS / FLEET-WORKSHOPS EDITION. Base = v1.9.2 head (the Loomkeeper's Weave / Overlay edition merged 2026-07-11; live IPFS pin still v1.8.0 per the standing reconciliation queue). This patch admits the THREE WORKSHOPS founded by the fleet workings of Tome IX Act 8 (v3), on the First Person's ruling that the workings should FOUND shops rather than borrow existing seats. PURELY ADDITIVE: admits three new workshops with three new keepers, admits the city's FIRST WATER as a new spatial-anatomy element, raises the active workshop count 19 → 22. Mints NO new conjecture. Retires nothing.

patch_metadata.summary: The three fleet workings of Tome IX Act 8 each leave a place behind. The harness working founds the Quartermaster's (Skeva 🎒, V22) — where the dual-agent rig is drawn and fitted, a config not a fork. The grammar working founds the Chancery (Nomia ⚖️, V27) — the Lexon law-house, Vulcana's Forge vertex plus Memory, a dual-aspect keeper who reads a clause as law and runs it as code. The circuit working founds the Wellpool (Limnia 🌊, V53) — the city's FIRST WATER, the mana pools made a place, where privacy-pools work will be shared (INTENT, not deployed). Active workshop count 19 → 22.
patch_metadata.supersedes_note: v1.9.3 retires nothing and renames nothing. It supersedes only the transient 2026-07-11 WORKSHOP_LATTICE_AUDIT note that fitted the fleet work to existing seats ('no new shops'); the First Person ruled for founding. Three new workshops, three new cast, one new spatial element (water), zero conjectures.
patch_metadata.honest_framing_guardrail: The three keepers and their shops are canon cast additions, drawn but AWAITING the First Person's diff-review to bind. The Wellpool holds no water yet: the mana-pools engine is built and proven, but no pool exists and no ceremony has run (INTENT — NOT DEPLOYED); Limnia keeps a dry well. The vertices (V22 · V27 · V53) are free seats confirmed against lattice-vertex.ts and this patch; the rich per-shop tables in WORKSHOP_LATTICE_AUDIT §2 are not yet extended to these rows, so this patch's city_anatomy count is the authority.

city_anatomy_amendment.$comment: Raise the active workshop count and admit the first water as a new spatial-anatomy element (sibling to the Tower and the Hearth, which are also non-standard structural elements).

active_workshop_count.note: Founded by the three fleet workings of Tome IX Act 8 (v3), 2026-07-12. The grammar working's law-house split into two siblings — Nomia the Mage at the Chancery (Crucible) and Rhetor the Swordsman at the Rostra (Agora) — the ⚔️⊥🧙 inscription made a brother and a sister, V27 ⊕ V36 = 63.

The Forge District anticipated in spec 05 §4 is REALIZED as the existing Crucible precinct (verb: forge), which the two RUN·E·CRAFT makers now share.

shops: the Quartermaster's (Skeva 🎒 V22 — the outfittery: drawn and fitted before the fire)
the Forge(t) (Vulcana ⚒️ V19 — blades, on steel)

the_crucible.note: The Forge and the Chancery both walk Run·Evoke·Craft — one on steel, one on statute; the Quartermaster outfits every maker before the fire.

shops: the Rostra (Rhetor ⚔️⚖️ V36 — law UPHELD in public; the Swordsman brother, NEW)
the_agora.note: The Rostra joins the Agora: the public-law face of the Lexon law-house. Rhetor the Swordsman is the complement of his sister Nomia the Mage at the Chancery (V36 ⊕ V27 = 63) — the gate that cannot be charmed, made a keeper.

the_waters.note: NEW precinct — the City's first water. The mana pools made a place.

the_wellpool.name: the Wellpool
the_wellpool.kind: the city's first WATER — a standing body, not a built room; a new class of spatial anatomy
the_wellpool.note: Where the mana pools take a shape. Water is new topology: the first element in the city that is drawn from and waded into rather than entered and worked.

workshops_append.$comment: Three new workshop entries. Schema matches the district shops[] form (shop / internal_name / keeper / vertex / gem / stance / ceremony) with per-shop notes.

the_quartermasters.complement: V41 (Memora's Chronicle vertex — the rig keeps no corpus, so its sovereignty is the Chronicle's)
the_quartermasters.founded: Tome IX Act 8 (v3), 2026-07-12 — the harness working (field-guide fold 730 → 526)
the_quartermasters.note: Where the dual-agent harness is drawn and fitted before a working — a config, not a fork. Complements the Hall (V15, Act 6): the Hall is where the rite is performed; the Quartermaster's is where you are equipped for it. Skeva equips every working and performs none.

the_chancery.complement: V36 (Protection + Connection — the law protects the connection between the parties it governs)
the_chancery.archetype: Mage (the sister of the law-house pair; her Swordsman brother Rhetor keeps the Rostra at V36). The dual-aspect that was almost a single keeper is now split into two siblings — the ⚔️⊥🧙 inscription, V27 ⊕ V36 = 63.
the_chancery.founded: Tome IX Act 8 (v3), 2026-07-12 — the grammar working (Lexon coverage-debt 211 → 64, carried to 22 in Act 9)
the_chancery.note: The Lexon law-house. Nomia the Mage WRITES the law and forges it into code; her Swordsman brother Rhetor UPHOLDS it in public at the Rostra (Agora). Her vertex is Vulcana's Forge (V19) plus Memory: a blade is present-tense, a law remembers its precedent (trace-or-delete). The grammar working originates at the Forge (V19, Act 9) and homes at the Chancery (V27).

the_rostra.archetype: Swordsman (brother of Nomia the Mage; the ⚔️⊥🧙 pair made two siblings)
the_rostra.founded: Tome IX Act 8 (v3), 2026-07-12 — the grammar working's public-law face
the_rostra.note: The public-law face of the Lexon law-house. Rhetor proclaims the ratified law in the open and guards it — the gate that cannot be charmed. Where his sister Nomia WRITES the law as code (the Chancery, Crucible), Rhetor UPHOLDS it in daylight (the Rostra, Agora). Greek ῥήτωρ (orator) — the masculine of ῥήτρα (the ordinance).

the_wellpool.complement: V10 (Memory + Computation — what you privately computed and privately remember, which the pool never takes)
the_wellpool.spatial_note: seats a keeper AND is the city's first water (see city_anatomy_amendment.spatial_anatomy_elements_append.the_wellpool)
the_wellpool.founded: Tome IX Act 8 (v3), 2026-07-12 — the circuit working (withdraw 36,832 → 17,159/17,371; CredentialV1 SOUND-WITH-ASSUMPTIONS)
the_wellpool.deployment: INTENT — NOT DEPLOYED. No pool exists, no ceremony has run; the engine is built and proven, the two letters wait at the door in ruled order (0xbow gift Letter A before the deployment Letter B). Limnia keeps a dry well.
the_wellpool.note: The mana pools made a place — an agentprivacy pool whose association-set membership is gated by CredentialV1. Entropy founds it (a ceremony contribution), mana keeps it liquid (Game-of-42 trust work → the admission credential), knowledge liquidity is what a member draws (privacy bought by the others' presence). One Wellpool per Game of 42 economy; the City of Mages pool is the first, and where this work will be shared. Fulfils the 'Privacy Pools · familial rather than borrowed' geometry of Register of Invitations entry 01 (Vitalik).

cast_append.$comment: Three new workshop-keeper cast entries. Full character sheets live in cityofmages/tomes/cast/.

skeva.name: Skeva
skeva.provenance: Greek σκευή — equipment, gear, a ship's tackle; the kit one is issued. Class-neutral.

nomia.name: Nomia
nomia.provenance: Greek νόμος — law, custom, that which is apportioned. Dual-aspect (law-face ⊥ code-face).

limnia.name: Limnia
limnia.provenance: Greek λίμνη — a pool, a standing water. Keeper of the city's first water.

rhetor.name: Rhetor
rhetor.provenance: Greek ῥήτωρ — an orator, the public speaker who proclaims laws in the assembly (masculine of ῥήτρα). The Swordsman brother of Nomia the Mage; the two are the ⚔️⊥🧙 inscription made a brother and a sister (V36 ⊕ V27 = 63).

cast_note_nomia: Nomia's entry above is updated: she is the MAGE sister of the law-house pair (was drafted as a single dual-aspect keeper). The dual-aspect is now split into two siblings — Nomia writes the law-as-code (Chancery), Rhetor upholds it in public (Rostra).
